recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core source follow-up is needed; any residual concern belongs to historic STU3 generated schematron artifacts rather than current source.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core-CareTeam reporting that the generated STU3 schematron version of ctm-1 falsely rejected relative Practitioner/... references because of the leading-slash XPath test.
initial_application: The same XPath defect was already corrected by FHIR-13293 in commit bd3f8a7ba5aba2347a6542d772cdc96897766a9c, and the FHIR-21219 Jira comment records that the resource was already fixed. Commit 88a1f3d6bd60f7618ae140179b008ac5686e8a08 later removed checked-in ElementDefinition XPath values from the current CareTeam source.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-02-08 list FHIR-21219 as Persuasive. FHIR-42928 later broadened CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf and removed ctm-1, so the current source has no active ctm-1 XPath or schematron-style string-reference constraint.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current core build source is already beyond the requested correction: no active XPath field remains and the old ctm-1 invariant has been intentionally removed.
